ValidationRule.description: VR-OPP-02: Win/Loss notes must be at least 5 characters on 9-Lost and 5-Won outcomes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "9-Lost"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5-Won") ), NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)), NOT(ISBLANK(Loss_Notes__c)), LEN(Loss_Notes__c) < 5 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Win/Loss notes must be at least 5 characters. Please describe the outcome.
